# 使用指南

_Using the Library_

## 阅读与检索 / Reading & Search

从首页选择一级主题，再进入专题导读。中英文标题、正文与术语对应排列；右上角“⋯”可搜索条目和文件。

_Choose a subject area on the home page, then open a topic guide. Titles, study notes and terminology are paired in Chinese and English. Use the upper-right menu to search entries and files._

## 预览与下载 / Preview & Download

在资料区点击预览打开文档，点击下载保存原件。线上 Office 演示文件使用 PDF 预览，原件仍保留原格式；专业 PDF 保持来源语言。

_Open a preview to read a document, or download the original. Office demonstration files use PDF previews while retaining the original download format. Technical PDFs retain their source language._

## 维护资料库 / Maintaining the Library

上传和编辑在本地 Nextcloud 中完成，原件保存一份，通过 Wiki 链接关联。公开主站是经过白名单导出和核对的快照。

_Uploads and editing take place in local Nextcloud. Keep one original and connect it through Wiki links. The public site is an explicitly allowlisted and checked snapshot._
